[ASSISTANT_SAID] Bulgogi is a beloved Korean dish that's easy to make at home.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Bulgogi recipe includes:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 1 lb thinly sliced beef (ribeye or sirloin), cut into bite-sized pieces  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 2 cloves of garlic, minced  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 1 tablespoon grated ginger  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 1/4 cup soy sauce  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 1/4 cup Korean chili flakes (gochugaru)  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 2 tablespoons brown sugar  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 2 tablespoons sesame oil  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 1/4 cup chopped green onions, for garnish  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - Sesame seeds, for garnish (optional)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Instructions for bulgogi preparation include marinating the beef and grilling it.
